description: "Biographical Memorials of James Oglethorpe" by Thaddeus Mason Harris is a historical account published in the early 19th century. The book centers on James Oglethorpe, the distinguished founder of the Colony of Georgia in North America, detailing his life, notable achievements, and the innovative principles that guided his philanthropic endeavors.
